blocks.body:
## Current verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The canonical August 31 capture at 02:51:00 +05:00 fails every required goal surface, so the verified streak remains 0/7: Apple weather search is #88, the official Apple Weather chart is #40, all three fixed logged-out Google category profiles are outside the first 30, and 0/5 generic Google queries qualify. The auxiliary Apple Toshkent ob-havo search returned only one unique result and remains a non-goal diagnostic error; required goal evidence is complete. The current App Store Connect overview reports 300 impressions, 23 product-page views, 8 first downloads, 1 redownload, 3 updates, and 4.86% conversion; retention is insufficient. The conversion is preserved as reported because the supplied counts and report window do not reproduce it. Public iOS 1.0.1 (4) now has two reported crashes, one on August 25 and one on August 29. The August 29 event maps to iPhone; the August 25 device/OS dimension is suppressed or unavailable, and neither exposes a diagnostic, stack, incident/signature ID, or crashed-binary UUID. The crash gate therefore remains blocked. Google overview values are carried forward from August 28 and were not revalidated on August 31.

Current product/build-input commit 2cdd4387fc2b8b0f4cd3e3a873f019a6ca8a3652 keeps phone 1.1.0 (8), Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000008), and Apple 1.1.0 (6), with fail-closed Apple source-revision plumbing and deterministic per-target release profiles. It tolerates omitted optional Open-Meteo forecast/AQI arrays while keeping required weather/time rows fail-closed. Fourteen targeted Android-host and twelve targeted iOS Simulator tests pass. Exact-source GitHub Actions run 33300967788 passed ordinary Android/iOS, all 15 API 24/API 36 phone/tablet Compose UI tests, and all 18 Apple surface-state tests. Its retained archives are unsigned/test regression evidence only. Exact-source debug APK and pulled installed bytes share SHA-256 prefix d66c8f0 and passed a bounded physical API 25 phone/widget smoke, including denied location, Bukhara search, live forecast, cache/recovery, process health, and cleanup. This is debug-certificate evidence, not upload signing. The protected master-only hosted run 33381050098 passed both jobs with all 8/8 signing inputs and produced retained, independently byte-verified phone, Wear, and Apple candidates. The schema-v3 receipt proves 3/3 candidate bytes. Hosted materialization run 33392732428 then validated the exact source artifact/package/receipt bindings and retained the package and receipt as hash-bound assets in unpublished draft release 379745439. A fresh local macOS run then reopened those exact assets, verified pinned Bundletool, and returned byte_verified=true for all three outputs. The committed manifest is atomically 3/3 verified-current and remains draft-blocked because the upload-derived Android and TestFlight Apple physical matrices are missing. The protected hosted repeat is pending until its workflow executes. Predecessor commit 9c2dce4200dbba5487c8c458ade4616005fde6e6 closes three deterministic storage-failure exception escapes and adds four throwing-repository regressions, but all of its binaries, screenshots, and device results are historical and non-transferable. OpenMeteo GmbH confirmed non-commercial API entitlement in ticket 234272 for the exact free, non-monetized, unpaid-organic-promotion scope. Predecessor phone and Wear AABs embed 9c2dce4, pass Bundletool and ZIP integrity, and have zero signature entries. Their SHA-256 values are b7c7acb6e90189e8d73e5b8a5f780bf1d3ab36f43edaf3d5076a1dba4e22d4e5 and 2d73fdf1e4fd661a96a699a9fd2ef7b2e989b0f4ab019692ce7c97465673d3fa. Predecessor Apple app, widget, and watch Release simulator hashes are b7c3ba937658007b07ee9ad8e85ddc892e90f423e7839e0dc112a1070ea04849, 7191acd40334d4d9fec6062bc5023450fefbb55006fbd92f57109f41eb27a7ff, and c310c785750ffa779e5dfdc30384088fca889deddb11417f2b4e8e0e30109728; UUID-matched dSYMs verify, but all are ad-hoc simulator products. The full Gradle release gate, shared iOS simulator suite, 18 Apple surface tests, and localization parity pass. A clean predecessor physical General Mobile API 25 run passed Tashkent without location permission, live forecast, truthful late-day Best Time, durable-tip persistence, offline cache, recovery, process health, and cleanup; built and installed APK bytes matched at 52146b883a04e4c2d272ea4e3ecc9b1277a8c78c117b547a121de3a7d90c3730 and the product-scoped fatal/ANR/SSL/CertPath/trust-anchor filter had zero matches. The exact-source API 24 emulator APK 168bb6acdb95453a8dfd141947edbcb9292b756fd3429fffa56fc4baf125dbec retains its live/cache/recovery pass. The byte-identical predecessor debug APK and API 36 installed bytes 52146b883a04e4c2d272ea4e3ecc9b1277a8c78c117b547a121de3a7d90c3730 also passed a fresh no-snapshot Pixel Tablet emulator smoke in Uzbek: landscape onboarding, live forecast, Best Time, durable-tip persistence, home-screen widget render/tap, large text, rotation, process health, and cleanup passed. This is emulator debug evidence, not physical-tablet or upload-signed release proof. Twelve EN/RU/UZ iPhone phone sources now come from the source-bound predecessor 9c2dce4 build-6 simulator app and cover overview, recent comparison, selected timeline, and 10-day/AQI details in each locale. The attempted Apple offline transition was not captured and no Apple offline-state source is claimed. This proves localized phone screenshot provenance only, not signing, physical-device, TestFlight, or store state. Apple Watch sources remain historical build-5 simulator evidence, and prior API 37 round-Wear evidence remains historical. Exact-current signed phone/Wear and Apple candidates are retained and byte-verified, but they are not manifest-promoted or store-delivered; there is no iOS 15 runtime pass or matching physical matrix. Android Keychain metadata and the existing mode-600 keystore remain present. Protected run 33381050098 used all 8/8 signing inputs and yielded a retained, independently byte-verified package; manifest promotion and physical delivery remain separate. At the August 31 read-only device check, the iPad mini 5 was paired, unlocked, and DDI-ready with Nimbo absent; the iPhone 14 Pro was paired but locked/DDI-blocked, and the paired Series 5 watch was visible but offline for detail/app queries. Google Play Custom Store Listing 4834799756935529888 remains an Uzbekistan-only draft. Authenticated App Store Connect inventory reads expose public iOS 1.0.1 with valid build 4 and no 1.1.0 version or builds 5/6. Build-detail and diagnostic-signature GETs for build 4 returned security 403. One bounded POST attempting to create only a manual-release 1.1.0 version also returned 403; the final authenticated GET again returned zero 1.1.0 versions, proving that no partial version or localization draft was created. No build, localization, screenshot, Custom Product Page, submission, or release mutation followed. Apple subtitles and creatives remain repository-prepared payloads, not an App Store Connect draft or public store state. The same authenticated preflight found zero existing analytics report requests. Exactly one bounded ONGOING analytics-report-request POST for app 6799886897 returned security 403 without a resource ID; it was not retried, and no duplicate, report instance, segment, user-level data, or PII was created or downloaded. Automated weekly Apple analytics remains permission-blocked for the current key. The domain and point-in-time store-policy gates remain pass, every critical console guardrail remains unknown, and the latest validated weekly Play slice has zero UZ visitors, so UZ conversion remains unknown; its 42.31% all-country rate is diagnostic only. Scale status remains hold; public outreach and acquisition scaling remain gated on crash diagnosis, full trusted macOS verification and atomic manifest promotion of the materialized candidates, complete physical-device coverage, and critical console guardrails.

## Authenticated Play context

At 23:37–23:46 +05:00 on August 29, the global default rating remained 1.000 from one user and the all-time review inbox contained zero written reviews. The lone star-only rating has no reply surface and is not attributed to Uzbekistan, a device, version, or storefront. Account-level email notifications were enabled and saved for new one- through five-star reviews and edited reviews; the dashboard contains no email address, reviewer data, or other PII. The daily heartbeat checks the Nimbo review inbox once per day after 09:15 Asia/Tashkent.

The rolling Last 28 days acquisition snapshot showed 778 device impressions, 21 installs, 14 first opens, 11 monthly active devices, unavailable D7 retention, and 40.82% summary conversion. The historical baseline remains 779 impressions. The separate July 27–August 23 Store Listings window showed 44 visitors, 18 install clicks, and 41% CTR across listing surfaces; its default-listing row separately showed 42 visitors and 28.6% conversion. These populations are not merged. In the exact August 16–22 report, UZ remained requested but its series was omitted from both Console and CSV, so no UZ visitor, acquisition, or conversion value is imported, zero-filled, or derived. Evidence: growth/quality/google-play-console-2026-08-29.md, growth/quality/weekly-console-evidence-2026-08-29.md, and growth/reviews/README.md.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, release identity, domain, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. External UI side effects remain action-time gated by the execution surface, and the zero-budget boundary remains in force.

-- Reproducible bounded store-evidence snapshot as of 2026-08-31.
-- Apple overview values are current read-only observations. Google values and
-- Apple ratings are carried forward from 2026-08-28 and explicitly marked.
SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('App Store', 'Impressions', '300', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('App Store', 'First-time downloads', '8', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('App Store', 'Conversion rate', '4.86%', 'live_console_2026-08-31_reported'),
    ('App Store', 'Ratings', '0', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated'),
    ('App Store', 'Crashes', '2', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'Impressions', '779', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated'),
    ('Google Play', 'Installations', '21', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated'),

-- Baseline-versus-target percentages used in the growth control room.

    ('Apple conversion', 'Target', 0.1500),

SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('ios_crash_gate', 'iOS crash gate', 'blocked', 'Authenticated App Store Connect reports two crashes for public iOS 1.0.1 (4): one on 2026-08-25 and one on 2026-08-29. The 2026-08-29 event maps to iPhone; the 2026-08-25 device/OS dimension is suppressed or unavailable. Neither event exposes a diagnostic, stack, incident/signature ID, or crashed-binary UUID. Current product commit 2cdd4387fc2b8b0f4cd3e3a873f019a6ca8a3652 inherits preventive storage-failure hardening and tolerant optional Open-Meteo decoding; ordinary exact-source run 33300967788 passed shared Simulator tests and 18/18 Apple surface-state tests. Protected run 33381050098 now also provides a retained, independently byte-verified distribution-signed 1.1.0 (6) IPA/archive with matching profiles, entitlements, signatures, and dSYM UUIDs. That candidate is not the crashed public build, has not been uploaded or exercised through TestFlight, and cannot identify or be attributed to either production event. Diagnostic access and symbolication, an exact TestFlight physical iPhone/iPad/widget/watch pass, and post-rollout crash evidence remain missing.', 'Obtain and symbolicate any diagnostic Apple exposes, upload the exact retained IPA unchanged to TestFlight, complete the iPhone/iPad/widget/watch matrix, and collect post-rollout evidence'),
    ('open_meteo_promotion_clearance', 'Open-Meteo promotion clearance', 'pass', 'The complete authenticated Gmail record was checked read-only on 2026-08-29. The 06:05:07 +05:00 request described Nimbo as free and non-monetized, with no subscriptions, advertising, paid features, affiliate links, accounts, analytics SDK, or sale of user data, and limited promotion to unpaid localized posts, one personalized contact plus at most one follow-up, genuine Apple/Google editorial submissions, and ordinary unpaid links. At 17:25 +05:00, Nicoletta Addimando via OpenMeteo GmbH replied in ticket 234272 and explicitly confirmed that under those terms Nimbo is entitled to use the non-commercial API. This pass is limited to that exact scope and the published Free API limits; monetization, paid promotion, attribution removal, limit changes, or other material facts require a new licensing decision.', 'Preserve the confirmed scope and reopen licensing review before any material monetization, promotion, attribution, endpoint, or usage-limit change'),
    ('release_artifact_source_sync', 'Release artifact source sync', 'pass', 'Product/build-input commit 2cdd4387fc2b8b0f4cd3e3a873f019a6ca8a3652 resolves to Android phone 1.1.0 (8), Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000008), and Apple 1.1.0 (6). Exact-source ordinary GitHub Actions run 33300967788 passed Android/shared, Apple, and all 15 Compose UI tests across API 24 phone, API 36 phone, and API 36 tablet. Protected signing run 33381050098 produced the schema-v3 receipt-bound source-current set. Hosted materialization run 33392732428 retained the exact package and receipt in unpublished mutable draft release 379745439. On 2026-08-31 a fresh local macOS verification downloaded and rechecked the exact draft state and asset IDs, sizes, and SHA-256 values, safely extracted the 104-file closed tree, verified pinned Bundletool 1.18.3, and ran the full artifact verifier against the intended atomic manifest. It returned byte_verified=true for phone d4a90676f32745ea314b50ced2c9955e86923589534a1a7654ac6f1207e88a62, Wear e76d685b20e86f8878be7c9a1a59ac6edb5781ec8e61d5ecd36feb52ddc1cccf, and Apple 7466afb1a06f3000ad5d095734082d57cf58e992bdd7a8bed326e90d26ba39d0, including Android identity/upload-certificate/source checks and Apple app/widget/watch identity, profile, entitlement, executable, and dSYM checks. The committed manifest now promotes all 3/3 entries atomically to verified-current and retains status draft-blocked because physical QA and store delivery remain separate. Evidence is growth/quality/release-artifact-full-verification-2026-08-31-local.md. A protected read-only hosted macOS repeat after CI succeeds on master is still pending and must recheck the mutable draft before any later use. No physical-device, TestFlight, Play internal, store upload, processing, review, publication, public availability, crash-gate, or ranking claim follows from this pass.', 'Let the protected read-only hosted macOS workflow repeat the full pinned verifier after CI succeeds on master, then bind exact physical QA without changing the promoted artifact bytes'),
    ('android_physical_smoke', 'Android device smoke', 'blocked', 'Product commit 2cdd4387fc2b8b0f4cd3e3a873f019a6ca8a3652 exact debug APK and pulled installed bytes SHA-256 d66c8f0f9b05232cf484bd95223328a44f2a0bddf1d2f76817ef9504f87fe047 passed a clean physical General Mobile Android 7.1.1 / API 25 smoke in Russian, covering denied approximate location, ordinary Bukhara search, live forecast, cached cold start, failed-refresh warning, recovery, populated widget render/tap, process health, and cleanup. Protected run 33381050098 now also provides retained, independently byte-verified upload-key-signed phone AAB d4a90676f32745ea314b50ced2c9955e86923589534a1a7654ac6f1207e88a62 and Wear AAB e76d685b20e86f8878be7c9a1a59ac6edb5781ec8e61d5ecd36feb52ddc1cccf from the same product source. The AABs cannot be installed directly. No upload-key-signed universal APK derived from the exact phone AAB has yet been installed on the currently clean API 25 device, and no byte-linked physical tablet/widget or paired Wear OS result exists. The Samsung API 36 device already has Nimbo data and is not mutated without a safe update identity. No Play upload, processing, app-signing-key delivery, internal track, or public rollout is claimed. The gate remains blocked.', 'Derive or deliver an upload-key-signed universal APK from the retained phone AAB, then run phone/tablet/widget and paired Wear OS physical QA without overwriting existing user data'),
    ('ios_physical_smoke', 'iOS physical smoke', 'blocked', 'Historical product commit 9c2dce4200dbba5487c8c458ade4616005fde6e6 retains simulator-only Apple evidence that does not transfer to current authority 2cdd4387fc2b8b0f4cd3e3a873f019a6ca8a3652. Twelve targeted current-source iOS Simulator provider tests and exact-source hosted Apple regression tests pass. Protected run 33381050098 now provides retained, independently byte-verified distribution-signed IPA 7466afb1a06f3000ad5d095734082d57cf58e992bdd7a8bed326e90d26ba39d0 plus matching xcarchive, app/widget/watch profiles, entitlements, signatures, and dSYM UUIDs for 1.1.0 (6). Because the IPA uses App Store profiles, direct devicectl installation is invalid; exact runtime proof must use that unchanged upload through TestFlight. The iPad mini 5 is currently paired, unlocked, DDI-ready, and has no Nimbo install. The iPhone 14 Pro is paired but locked and DDI-blocked; the paired Series 5 watch is visible but offline for detail/app queries. No iOS 15 runtime is locally available. No TestFlight upload/processing/install, physical iPhone/iPad/widget/watch pass, or post-rollout crash evidence exists. The gate remains blocked.', 'Upload the exact retained IPA unchanged to TestFlight, unlock the iPhone and restore watch readiness, then run the complete iPhone/iPad/widget/watch matrix'),
    ('domain_activation', 'Domain activation', 'pass', 'At 2026-08-29 10:40–10:41 +05:00, authenticated GitHub Pages settings showed DNS check successful and Enforce HTTPS enabled. The Let''s Encrypt certificate has CN nimbo.uz, SANs nimbo.uz/www.nimbo.uz, and validates for both hosts. WHOIS, .uz delegation, authoritative Cloudflare records, and independent 1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8 resolution pass. HTTPS returns 200 with verification result 0 for all 12 published UZ-root/RU/EN landing, press, privacy, and support routes plus growth, robots, sitemap, and the valid metadata schema. HTTP apex redirects to HTTPS; HTTP www reaches HTTPS apex in two redirects; HTTPS www redirects directly to HTTPS apex. All 12 localized HTML routes have the expected HTTPS canonical and language. Uzbek intentionally uses ' || chr(47) || ' rather than a separate ' || chr(47) || 'uz' || chr(47) || ' route.', 'Maintain dated DNS, certificate, redirect, canonical, and localized-route verification at each release'),
    ('store_policy_console_clearance', 'Store policy console clearance', 'pass', 'The 2026-08-28 App Store read-only check found no open review/compliance action. Google Play reported no policy issues at 2026-08-29 13:12 +05:00; production remained active at 1.0.2 (6), 100%. At 13:59:40 +05:00, UZ Custom Store Listing 4834799756935529888 was saved only as Draft, not submitted for review or published; Publishing overview still showed the latest publication on 2026-08-27. This is point-in-time Console evidence, not a guarantee against later review. See growth/quality/store-policy-console-2026-08-28.md and growth/quality/google-play-console-2026-08-29.md.', 'Re-check both app-global store policy surfaces at the next evidence cutoff')
) AS gates(gate_id, gate, status, evidence, next_action);
query.description: Loads the fail-closed scale gates and their next evidence-producing action. Scale status is hold. Public outreach and acquisition scaling remain gated on iOS crash diagnosis, complete exact-build physical-device and internal-delivery coverage, the pending protected hosted repeat before later artifact use, and critical console guardrails. Open-Meteo written clearance passes for the exact unpaid, non-monetized organic-promotion scope, and the exact source-current signed artifact set is now atomically verified-current in the still draft-blocked upload manifest.
tables_used: inline gate values backed by growth/quality/gates.json
metric_definitions: Blocked and pending are not pass

query.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('ios_crash_free_sessions_pct','iOS crash-free sessions','unknown',TRUE,'>= 99.8%','block_scale','Attach the source-defined App Store crash-free-session metric for the same UZ evidence window'),('android_user_perceived_crash_rate_pct','Android user-perceived crash rate','unknown',TRUE,'< 1.09%','block_scale','Import the Play Console UZ user-perceived crash rate for the same seven complete days'),('android_user_perceived_anr_rate_pct','Android user-perceived ANR rate','unknown',TRUE,'< 0.47%','block_scale','Import the Play Console UZ user-perceived ANR rate for the same seven complete days'),('android_phone_model_crash_rate_pct','Android phone-model crash rate','unknown',TRUE,'< 8%','review_required','Import decision-eligible concrete phone-model crash evidence and review the worst observed model'),('android_phone_model_anr_rate_pct','Android phone-model ANR rate','unknown',TRUE,'< 8%','review_required','Import decision-eligible concrete phone-model ANR evidence and review the worst observed model'),('wear_model_crash_rate_pct','Wear OS model crash rate','unknown',TRUE,'< 4%','review_required','Import decision-eligible concrete Wear OS model crash evidence and review the worst observed model'),('wear_model_anr_rate_pct','Wear OS model ANR rate','unknown',TRUE,'< 5%','review_required','Import decision-eligible concrete Wear OS model ANR evidence and review the worst observed model'),('open_policy_issues','App-global store policy issues','unknown',TRUE,'= 0','block_scale','Import current app-global Apple and Google policy-issue counts with storefront ALL')) AS guardrails(guardrail_id,guardrail,status,critical,threshold,unknown_policy,next_action)
query.description: Loads every critical metric guardrail and keeps missing evidence explicitly unknown.
tables_used: inline guardrail values backed by growth/reports/evaluation-2026-08-31.json and growth/kpi-framework.json
metric_definitions: Unknown follows each guardrail's configured unknown_policy
The app-global point-in-time open_policy_issues metric requires both storefront ALL records and remains distinct from the operational store_policy_console_clearance gate
